main_issue: Whether alcohol can be at the housewarming in the flat, given D's religious objection and A and B's commitments; resolved by serving drinks at the void deck.

A-B.evidence: Both wanted drinks at the party; B balked at the void deck (21), then agreed 'Okay, fine. The void deck' (26) and A said 'settled' (27).

A-C.evidence: C proposed the cooler box (8) and the void deck (17); A adopted the void deck (20) and C confirmed 'Good. Settled.' (29).

A-D.evidence: A wanted drinks in the fridge, D refused alcohol at home (4-6); D accepted the void deck (18) and A agreed 'Drinks at the void deck' (27).

B-C.evidence: B rejected D's payback offer (16); C's void deck idea (17) was accepted by B after hesitation (26); C: 'Settled' (29).

B-D.evidence: B had told guests there would be drinks (7, 16), D's offer to pay didn't help B; both ended up accepting drinks at the void deck (18, 26).

C-D.evidence: D declined the cooler box (9); C understood 'at all' (10); D accepted C's void deck idea (18); C 'Settled' (29).
